Hey, I'm

Vaishnav
Sairam.

Heyo! I'm Vaishnav. I'm From Kochi, Kerala (cue the idli-sambhar_dosa meme). I'm a 4th year Mechanical Engineering student at BITS Pilani KK Birla Goa Campus, and I'm currently in Mumbai pursuing my Bachelor's thesis at IIT Bombay.

I'm concerningly obsessed with Cars, Racing and Aviation. I (unfortunately) am a die-hard Ferrari and Chelsea fan, so if you can relate to my suffering, feel free to connect :). The final goal is to end up in F1, as an engineer. I dunno how far we'll reach. But life is too short not to try. If you ever need me, there's a 97.84% chance you'll find me in the library. Otherwise I like to do sim-racing and sketching.

Let's see where life takes us...
